# Private iMessage Codex Agent

> Implementation and operations index for a single-owner Spectrum Cloud iMessage agent with PostgreSQL durability, Codex execution, and optional Supermemory projection.

## Implementation entrypoints

- [`src/server.ts`](../src/server.ts) — executable production entrypoint; loads the production runtime and starts the staged lifecycle
- [`src/index.ts`](../src/index.ts) — generic boot/readiness/shutdown ordering used by the production entrypoint
- [`src/runtime/production-bootstrap.ts`](../src/runtime/production-bootstrap.ts) — production composition root for PostgreSQL, pg-boss, Codex, optional Supermemory, authorization, workers, and Spectrum
- [`src/http/server.ts`](../src/http/server.ts) — composed `/healthz` and `/readyz` handlers
- [`src/runtime/persistent-storage.ts`](../src/runtime/persistent-storage.ts) — Codex and workspace volume policy
- [`src/runtime/graceful-shutdown.ts`](../src/runtime/graceful-shutdown.ts) — bounded stop hooks
- [`src/db/migrate.ts`](../src/db/migrate.ts) — migration command
